transcript: Supply chain disruption pushed our lead time past ten weeks this quarter. Inflation is squeezing consumer demand across every region we serve. We opened twelve new stores and customers responded warmly.

A new competitor is driving pricing pressure in our core categories this quarter. Shipping delay at two ports left our inventory below plan for the summer. Management remains confident about the holiday outlook overall.

Tariff changes and new regulation add compliance costs we did not expect to carry this year. Interest rate uncertainty is weighing on discretionary spending among our customers. Online sales grew strongly across all channels.

Rising credit losses and higher debt service costs weighed on liquidity during the quarter. A regulatory investigation into our lending practices is ongoing at the moment. Deposits grew steadily through the period.

A cyber incident caused a short outage of our mobile app earlier in the quarter. Our leverage ratios remain within covenant limits despite the pressure on margins. Fee income improved on stronger advisory activity.

Market share losses to fintech competitors continue to pressure our consumer lending business. Geopolitical uncertainty and currency volatility are a headwind for our international desk. We completed the refinancing of our senior notes.
